text:
nina_park: quick async check-in for Arcadia Systems renewal — they saw a spike in webhook failures last night; severity: customer-facing but not full outage. what i did: reached out to customer, collected failure samples and timestamps, escalated to eng with logs. blockers: unsure if this is routing policy or dedicated pool throttling. today: need eng to confirm routing + temporary bypass so renewal demo tomorrow isn’t blocked. attaching snippet below.

omar_diaz: thanks — i'll start by checking routing policy history + model variant fallbacks. can you paste the sample timestamps? i’ll grep the logs.

nina_park: pasted below (trimmed):
```
2026-03-16T23:12:07Z arcadia webhook 429 rate_limit exceeded route=boston-dedicated
2026-03-16T23:12:08Z arcadia webhook retry attempt=1 -> 500 timeout kvcache-miss
2026-03-16T23:13:02Z arcadia webhook 200 ok on retry via fallback-model=redwood-lite
```

jen_sre: looks like mixed signals — some requests hit 429s on dedicated pool then fallback succeeded. can someone confirm their dedicated pool config (burst vs steady)?

lisa_se: arcadia's contract uses dedicated with burst enabled but limited to 60 rps sustained; their demo sends bursts ~120 rps for short periods.

omar_diaz: that aligns. hypothesis: autoscaler/credits didn't kick fast enough so requests hit rate limiter -> fallback to hosted variant. i'll check autoscaler logs and token bucket traces.

nate_cs: customer asks for ETA — renewal demo scheduled 09:30 PST tomorrow. if we can't guarantee dedicated path, can we route them to hosted catalog model for demo with blackout window noted? they'd accept that as contingency.

omar_diaz: short answer: i can confirm routing fallback path in ~45m after i fetch traces. longer fix (tune autoscaler or bump burst) needs ops/infra change and a release window. temporary mitigation: add explicit route policy for Arcadia to prefer hosted fallback immediately for the demo window.

jen_sre: ops note: if we immediately force hosted fallback via routing policy, we should tag requests with customer=arcadia-demo and enable tracing. deploy-bot, can you create a routing-policy change ticket (staging first)?

deploy-bot: created ticket INF-2026: routing-policy arcadia-demo -> staged in staging at 2026-03-17T01:10Z, PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/902

nina_park: thanks team. action items for today: @omar_diaz check autoscaler & token-bucket traces (ETA 45m). @jen_sre coordinate with infra for a quick routing policy toggle if needed. @lisa_se confirm customer accepts hosted-demo fallback and share approved contact message. i'll update customer in thread.

lisa_se: confirmed with Arcadia PM — they accept hosted fallback for demo and want the note: "we may use hosted variant during demo to ensure smooth UX; production will remain on dedicated." they also requested a short one-page note for renewal call.

omar_diaz: found autoscaler lag: scale-up delay ~27s due to cooldown + metric windowing for that GPU family. created a short runbook note: recommend lowering cooldown for arcadia's pool and pre-warming before demo. will paste proposed changes in 30m.

nate_cs: perfect. once we have runbook + staging PR, i'll relay to customer legal/sales for the renewal call.

jen_sre: following up — if we change cooldown we need infra sign-off; i've pinged infra channel and cc'd @eng-platform. they said quick config change ok but will require a maintenance window note. i'll coordinate.

nina_park: final for now — i'll send the customer the hosted-fallback note and mention we're actively adjusting autoscaler. will post update in 1h. thanks all :thumbsup:
